[EN] Finally, I've found the mysterious energy source the Mysterium researchers detected.

Simply standing near it causes pain. I don't know if I can destroy it. I want to steal it for the federation.

Either way, the argons must not possess this power."They won't if I can help it."
[ES] Por fin he encontrado la misteriosa fuente de energía que detectaron los investigadores de Mysterium.

El simple hecho de estar cerca de ella causa dolor. No sé si podré destruirla. Quiero robársela a la federación.

De cualquier forma, los argons no deben poseer este poder."They won't if I can help it."
